_comment: Shared by Pystino (gateway) and Cerea (chat), ADR 0093 §6.1. normalized = NFKC, strip, casefold (Python) / toLowerCase (TypeScript). trusted = may take part in an automatic trust decision (link, admin email, bootstrap): ASCII after normalisation and a valid address. normalized null = Python and TypeScript legitimately differ (casefold vs toLowerCase outside ASCII); only trusted=false is asserted for it. Keep both copies byte-identical.
